intent: The Registry names the collaboration behind every foreign key that crosses a Context, so an agent reading one table knows which Context supplies the rows it points at and what happens when they go.
observable_outcome: get-context batch, registry and operations each list the new interaction as reviewed, and the data readiness measurer counts every cross-context foreign key as covered.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An evaluation batch references the skill and skill version it ran against within its own Workspace, and is deleted with them when registry purges a deleted skill past its grace period; the purge never fails on a batch.
Every skill version ingest admits records the import source it came from, so the version joins to its skill_sources row.
Every operations change an operator makes, such as dismissing a finding, records the user identity resolved from the signed-in session as its operator.
